source: Chapter 673: “Sealing” Spell
target: Capitulum 673: Incantatio "Sigillandi"

source: Translator: CKtalon
target: Interpretator: CKtalon

source: Confirming his fears, Lumian slipped his key into the lock, easing the door to the suite open without a sound.
target: Timores suos confirmans, Lumian clavem suam in seram introduxit, sine sono ostium cubiculi aperiens.

source: Now, he knew without a doubt that Ludwig, the terrifying sealed creature, would unleash his hunger and frenzy at the Dream Festival.
target: Iam certe sciebat quod Ludwig, creatura sigillata et terribilis, famem ac furiam suam in Festum Somniorum exsolvet.

source: Beneath the crimson moonlight streaming through the window, Lugano thrashed wildly, his face twisted in agony.
target: Sub rubro lumine lunari, per fenestram effluentis, Lugano saeviter se convulsit, vultus eius in dolore distortus.

source: Lurking at the end of his flailing arm was Ludwig, dressed in a child’s nightcap and sky-blue pajamas dotted with yellow stars.
target: Insidians in extremitate brachii eius flagitantis, Ludwig apparuit, indutus in pileum puerile nocturnum et in pyjamas caeruleos, stellis flavescentibus maculatos.

source: The sickening sounds of bones crunching and flesh tearing filled the air.
target: Sordidi sonitus ossium crepantium et carnis laniandae aera implebant.

source: Amidst the chaos, droplets of blood splattered onto the floor.
target: Inter tumultum, guttae sanguinis in pavimentum sparsae sunt.

source: Suddenly, Ludwig lunged forward like a frenzied animal, his jaws closing in on Lugano’s arm with a sickening crack.
target: Subito, Ludwig, ut bestia furens, impetum fecit, mandibulae ejus ad brachium Lugano claudentibus, cum crepitu nauseabundo.

source: “All!”
target: “Omnes!”

source: Lugano’s scream pierced the air once more, threatening to blow the roof.
target: Clamor Lugani iterum aerem percurruit, minans tectum evellere.

source: Instinctively, he tried to wrench his arm free from Ludwig’s grasp and shove the creature away with his other hand. Pain seared through him, and he felt himself teetering on the edge of unconsciousness.
target: Instinctu conatus est brachium suum a Ludwig vinculis solvere et creaturam altera manu repellere. Dolor per eum ardebatur, atque se in confinio insciientiae vacillare sensit.

source: Observing Ludwig closely, Lumian darted behind him, his nostrils flaring.
target: Ludwig arcte observans, Lumian celeriter post eum se contulit, naribus effusis.

source: Two beams of white light shot forth from his nose, enveloping Ludwig. Ludwig paused, shutting his eyes.
target: Duo radii lucis albae e naso eius proiecerunt, Ludwig involventes. Ludwig cessavit, oculos clausit.

source: But before Lumian could react, the boy’s mouth resumed its relentless assault on Lugano’s arm, pulverizing bone and flesh alike.
target: Sed antequam Lumian agere posset, os pueri iterum impetum insatiabilem in brachium Lugano dedit, pulverizans ossa et carnem.

source: His eyes snapped open.
target: Oculi eius subito aperti sunt.

source: The Spell of Harrumph can only daze Ludwig for a moment, and that’s only if he’s sealed… Lumian reminded himself, taking a deep breath to steady his nerves.
target: Incantatio Harrumph Ludwig tantum per momentum obnubilare potest, et id solum si ille sigillatus est… Lumian se admonuit, spirum profundum sumens ad nervos suos temperandos.

source: He glanced at Lugano, who had noticed him but was too consumed by agony to speak. Raising a hand, Lumian motioned for Lugano to remain patient.
target: Ad Lugano intuitus est, qui eum animadvertit sed nimis dolore captus non poterat loqui. Manum levans, Lumian Lugano instavit ut patienter maneret.

source: Though Lugano’s mind raced with curses and frustration, he remained unable to voice them.
target: Quamquam mens Lugani maledicta et frustratione iterabat, ea verba exprimere non poterat.

source: As thoughts raced through his mind, Lumian gave an imperceptible nod.
target: Dum cogitationes in mente eius currerent, Lumian imperceptibiliter annuit.

source: Changing his focus, Lumian bypassed Ludwig, who was engrossed in devouring Lugano, and seized Lugano’s shoulder.
target: Focalem mutans, Lumian Ludwig praeteriit, qui Lugani vorando occupatus erat, et humerum Lugani arripuit.

source: In an instant, Lumian retrieved a sharp straight sword he had acquired from Port Santa, pulling it from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: In momento, Lumian gladium acutum et rectum, quem ab Porto Santa adeptus erat, extraxit ex sacculo Viatoris.

source: What is he trying to Jo? Amidst the throes of pain, Lugano’s thoughts scattered.
target: Quid conatur facere? In medio doloris, cogitationes Lugani dissipatae sunt.

source: With a swift motion, Lumian swung the sword, the blade bursting into white flames.
target: Celeriter motu, Lumian gladium percussit, cuius lamina in flammas albas erupta est.

source: The fiery sword crashed down upon Lugano’s arm, where Ludwig had been feasting, striking at the joint.
target: Gladius igniatus in brachium Lugani delapsus est, ubi Ludwig epulabatur, juncturam percutiens.

source: With a sharp sound, Lugano’s forearm tore away from Ludwig’s grasp, leaving behind a gory, truncated limb.
target: Cum sono acuto, antebrachium Lugani a conatu Ludovigi evulsum est, relinquens membrum cruentum et truncatum.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian’s form began to fade, and even Lugano, whom he had grasped, vanished from sight.
target: Simul, figura Lumiani evanescere coepit, et etiam Lugano, quem ceperat, ex conspectu evanuit.

source: Teleport!
target: Transloca!

source: But Lumian hadn’t gone far. Both he and Lugano reappeared at the suite’s doorway.
target: Sed Lumian non longe discesserat. Et ille atque Lugano iterum ad ostium cubiculi apparuerunt.

source: The agony persisted, but Lugano’s momentary relief vanished as Ludwig’s figure once again came into view. The sight of the boy, his mouth still bloody with Lugano’s remaining forearm, sent a shiver down his spine.
target: Agonia perseverabat, sed levamen momentaneum Lugani evanuit, cum figura Ludovigi iterum apparuit. Visio pueri, cuius os adhuc sanguinolentum ex antebrachio residuo Lugani manebat, tremorem per spinam eius intulit.

source: The fear momentarily eclipsed the pain, and Lugano’s mind raced with frantic questions.
target: Timor momento dolorem obumbravit, et mens Lugani quaestionibus ferventibus cursabat.

source: Why not teleport away from Tizamo?
target: Cur non translocari ex Tizamo?

source: Why not teleport to Port Pylos?
target: Cur non translocari ad Portum Pylos?

source: Why are we still lingering in front of Ludwig?
target: Cur adhuc coram Ludovigum manemus?

source: Meanwhile, Ludwig had turned his attention to the doorway, his blond hair matted with blood, his brown eyes glinting with ravenous hunger.
target: Interim, Ludwig animos suos ad ostium convertit, capillis flavis sanguine implicatis, oculis fuscis fame voraci micantibus.

source: With the speed of a child his age, he advanced toward Lumian and Lugano,
target: Celeritate pueri sui, ad Lumian et Lugano accessit,

source: all the while chewing and swallowing what remained of Lugano’s arm.
target: dum masticans et deglutiens quod reliquum erat ex brachio Lugani.

source: Unperturbed, Lumian calmly returned the straight sword to his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Imperturbatus, Lumian tranquille gladium rectum in sacculum Viatoris repositum est.

source: Under Lugano’s horrified gaze, Lumian conjured an entire almond pistachio cream thousand-layer cake and hurled it onto the floor beside Ludwig.
target: Sub aspectu horrido Lugani, Lumian totam placentam mille stratis, ex crema amygdalina et pistachiis factam, in pavimentum iuxta Ludovigum iecit.

source: Ludwig’s sprint slowed as he seemed to ponder which delicacy to indulge in first.
target: Velocitas Ludovigi retardavit, quasi quaerebat qua dulcedine primum se deliciarent.

source: Ultimately, he turned his attention back to Lugano.
target: Postremo, animos suos ad Lugano redegit.

source: The sight of blood, flesh, and marrow infused with spiritual essence seemed to intoxicate him even further.
target: Visio sanguinis, carnis, et medullae spiritu infuso eum adhuc magis inebriabat.

source: Capitalizing on Ludwig’s momentary indecision, Lumian delved into his Traveler’s Bag once more, extracting a fragment of Hisoka’s corpse and tossing it aside.
target: Ex indecisione momentanea Ludovigi fructificans, Lumian iterum in sacculum Viatoris immiscuit, fragmentum corporis Hisoka extrahens et proiecit.

source: Ludwig’s gaze followed the offering, his lips instinctively moistening, yet he made no move to change course.
target: Aspectus Ludovigi oblationem secutus est, labia ejus instinctu humidata, sed nihil ad cursum mutandum movebat.

source: It seemed he found the offering beneath his tastes, too dirty to be his top choice.
target: Videbatur oblationem repulsam esse ab appetitu suo, nimis sordidam ut optio praecipua esset.

source: Lumian systematically tossed out ingredients brimming with spiritual energy, one after the other, creating a barrier of tempting treats around Ludwig.
target: Lumian ingredientes spirituali energia plenos uno post alium systematice proiecit, murum ex delectabilibus suppellectibus circa Ludovigum condidit.

source: Cream pancakes, fruit tarts, sandwiches oozing with cream, bouchee a la reine, chocolates infused with liquor, cookies, candied plums, eclairs, Charlotte desserts, and a myriad of other delicacies formed a tempting ring around Ludwig, impeding his advance toward Lugano.
target: Placentae cremorosae, tartae fructuosae, panini cum cremo effluentes, bouchee à la reine, chocolatae liquore imbutae, biscottae, pruna dulcia confecta, éclairs, dolcia Charlotte, et innumerabilia alia delicia, circulum allicitium circa Ludovigum formaverunt, progressum eius ad Lugano impediendo.

source: Turning to Lugano with a stern expression, Lumian’s voice took on a commanding tone.
target: Ad Lugano cum vultu severo conversus, vox Lumiani tonum imperativum accepit.

source: “What are you waiting for? Stem the bleeding first!”
target: “Quid exspectas? Primo sanguinem sistere!”

source: Startled, Lugano obeyed, his left palm emitting a faint glow as he applied pressure to the stump of his injured arm.
target: Stupefactus, Lugano obtemperavit, palma sinistra leviter luce emittens, pressuram in truncum brachii laesi applicans.

source: As Ludwig indulged in the feast laid out before him, his urgency waned. Though still concerned for Lugano, he no longer rushed forward.
target: Dum Ludwig in epula ante se fruebatur, eius urgetio minuebatur. Quamquam pro Lugano adhuc sollicitus erat, non amplius procedebat.

source: In the final stages, Lumian threw out boxes of biscuits, sweets, beef jerky, and assorted provisions, encircling Ludwig with a haphazard yet effective “wall” of food.
target: In ultimis gradibus, Lumian cistulas ex biscotti, dulcibus, carne arida, et variis provisionibus proiecit, Ludwig circumcludens muro edulis, fortuito sed efficaci.

source: Nearly all of Lumian’s seven days’ worth of rations for Ludwig had been deployed from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Fere omnes rationes septem dierum, quas Lumian pro Ludovigo habebat, ex sacculo Viatoris editae erant.

source: “What… what’s the meaning of this?” Lugano, having successfully treated his wound and eased his pain, watched Lumian’s actions with bewilderment. He couldn’t fathom why his employer was so fixated on feeding Ludwig in the midst of their predicament.
target: “Quid... quid hoc significat?” inquit Lugano, vulnera sua sanata et dolorem levatum habens, actiones Lumiani perplexus observans. Non poterat intellegere cur dominus eius tam pertinaciter in Ludovigo alendo esset in medio tribulationis.

source: “Sealing that fellow,” Lumian replied calmly, his hands never ceasing their task.
target: “Illum sigillandum,” respondit Lumian tranquille, manibus officium suum numquam desinentes.

source: “Sealing?” Lugano nearly doubted his hearing.
target: “Sigillandum?” Lugano paene auditu suo dubitavit.

source: Isn’t this too absurd?
target: Nonne hoc nimis absurdum est?

source: Using food to seal a monster?
target: Adhibere cibum ad monstrum sigillandum?

source: He couldn’t recall ever encountering such a concept, not even in the most far-fetched novels on the market. No author would dream up such a peculiar method!
target: Non recordabatur umquam talem notionem convenisse, ne quidem in remotissimis fabulis mercatus. Nullus auctor talem methodum insolitam fingere audiret!

source: Wouldn’t a conventional seal involve the use of spiritually potent materials to inscribe mystical symbols and patterns, followed by ritualistic magic or the employment of a mystical artifact?
target: Nonne sigillum ordinarium implicat usum materiis spiritualibus potentibus ad inscriptionem symbolorum et formarum mysticarum, deinde magiam ritualem aut usum artifacti mystici?

source: What possible purpose could hurling food at the monster serve?
target: Quid prodest cibum in monstrum iactare?

source: Lumian smiled and sighed.
target: Lumian subridens suspiravit.

source: “Once he’s satiated, he won’t have any appetite left for you or anyone else here.
target: “Postquam saturatus erit, amplius tibi aut cuiquam alii hic appetitus non erit.

source: “And there’s enough food to keep him occupied until dawn, and possibly even beyond.”
target: “Et satis cibi est, ut eum occupatum teneat usque ad auroram, fortasse etiam ultra.”

source: Lumian had devised this plan upon realizing that Ludwig’s sole desire was to eat. Coupled with his behavior during the Dream Festival, Lumian was confident that Ludwig was now driven purely by his insatiable hunger—a unique trait exclusive to him in Tizamo.
target: Lumian hanc consiliam excogitaverat, cum animadvertisset unicum desiderium Ludovigi esse edendi. His rebus coniunctis, Lumian confidens erat Ludwigum nunc solum insatiabili fame impellitum esse, proprietate unicam in Tizamo praeditum.

source: In this scenario, as long as Ludwig’s appetite was sated, he could remain confined within the suite, feasting without posing a threat to others.
target: In hoc casu, dummodo appetitus Ludovigi saturetur, intra cubiculum manere poterit, epulans sine aliorum periculo.

source: What was the distinction between this and traditional sealing methods?
target: Quid erat discrimen inter hoc et modos sigillandi tradicionales?

source: Of course, the success of this makeshift seal depended on the Dream Festival concluding before Ludwig depleted the seven days’ worth of food.
target: Certe, successus huius sigilli improvisi pendebat ex Festo Somniorum finem antecedente, antequam Ludwig rationes septem dierum cibi exhaureret.

source: Otherwise, Lumian’s ability to hunt in the forest might not keep pace with Ludwig’s voracious appetite.
target: Alioquin, facultas Lumiani in silva venandi non aequaret famem voracem Ludovigi.

source: Lugano’s understanding dawned upon hearing Lumian’s explanation.
target: Intellectus Lugani oriturus est, cum audivit enuntiata Lumiani.

source: Indeed, this method offered a practical means of temporarily restraining Ludwig.
target: Revera, haec methodus viam practicam praebuit ad Ludwigum temporarie coercendum.

source: Who said it couldn’t be deemed a seal?
target: Quis dixerit id non posse sigillum haberi?

source: Understanding one’s target’s preferences and weaknesses allowed for the implementation of a seal without resorting to mysticism!
target: Cognoscendo praeferentias et infirmitates obiecti, sigillum instituere licuit sine aditu ad mysticismos!

source: Observing Ludwig still attempting to approach the door amidst his feast, Lumian realized the creature’s reluctance to part with Lugano. With a swift movement, he grasped Lugano’s shoulder and teleported them both to a corner of the second-floor stairwell in the police headquarters.
target: Observans Ludwigum adhuc conari ad ostium accedere inter epulam suam, Lumian animadvertit creaturae reluctantiam a Lugano dimittendi. Celeriter motu, humerum Lugani cepit et eos ambo ad angulum scalae secundae in praesidio vigilum translocavit.

source: Ludwig briefly glanced at the vacant doorway before refocusing on his culinary conquest within the suite.
target: Ludwig breviter ad ostium vacuum intuebatur, deinde ad victoriam suam culinariam intra cubiculum rediit.

source: “Are you certain everything’s under control?” Lugano inquired anxiously, the moment he exited the spirit world.
target: “Esne certus omnia sub potestate esse?” quaesivit Lugano anxie, cum ex mundo spirituum egrediretur.

source: Lumian chuckled in response.
target: Lumian subridens respondit.

source: “As long as no Beyonder happens to stroll by the door, he won’t abandon his feast.”
target: “Dummodo nemo Beyonder per ostium versetur, epulam suam non relinquet.”

source: Relieved, Lugano exhaled deeply, casting a rueful glance at his remaining arm. Thoughts swirled in his mind as he contemplated his future.
target: Levato animo, Lugano alte suspiravit, brachium reliquum suum maerens intuentem. Cogitationes per mentem eius gyrabant dum de futuro meditaret.

source: At least I’m still alive. As long as I’m alive…
target: Saltem adhuc vivus sum. Quamdiu vivo…

source: In the future, 1’11 see if 1 can save up enough money to afford a mechanical arm from the Church of Steam. That might bolster my combat strength.
target: In futuro, videam si satis pecuniae consertere possim ut brachium mechanicum ab Ecclesia Vaporis emere valeam. Id fortasse vim pugnandi meam augebit.

source: The Doctor’s expertise could only do so much, as transplanting another’s limb was beyond the realm of possibility.
target: Peritia Medici tantum in certa parte valebat, quia transplantatio alterius membrum extra fines possibilitatis erat.

source: Camus and Rhea, observing Lugano’s bloody limb, furrowed their brows, recalling Louis Berry’s ominous warning of a greater issue.
target: Camus et Rhea, membrum cruentum Lugani observantes, supercilia contraxerunt, recordantes monitionem Ludovici Berry de quaestione maiori.

source: “What happened?” Camus inquired.
target: “Quid accidit?” inquit Camus.

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian subridens.

source: “It’s a complication caused by that big problem, but I’ve managed to seal it temporarily. Just remember, stay away from the Brieu Motel, especially the door on the second-floor suite.”
target: “Complicatio est ex illa magna quaestione orta, sed eam temporarie sigillare potui. Memento: abstine a Brieu Motel, praesertim a porta cubiculi secundi.”

source: Relieved to hear that Louis Berry had intervened, Camus assured Lugano,
target: Levis animo, quod Louis Berry intercessisset, audito, Camus Lugano certiorem fecit,

source: “Thankfully, it’s all just a dream. You’ll be fine once you wake up.”
target: “Gratias Deo, omnia modo somnium sunt. Bene eris, cum expergisceris.”

source: “A dream?” Lugano was perplexed.
target: “Somnium?” inquit Lugano perplexus.

source: Lumian offered no further explanation, simply remarking, “Indeed, it’s a dream. But remember, if you perish in the dream, you perish in reality too.”
target: Lumian nullam ulteriorem explicationem attulit, sed simpliciter dixit, “Revera, somnium est. Sed memento, si in somnio peribis, in re ipsa peribis.”

source: Amid Lugano’s bafflement, Lumian redirected said to Camus and Rhea, “Let’s make our way to Twanaku’s house now.”
target: Inter perplexitatem Lugani, Lumian ad Camum et Rheam convertit et dixit, “Eamus nunc ad domum Twanaku.”

source: His primary objective in investigating the Dream Festival was to locate Hisoka’s gold and the item acquired from the Nois family’s Demon. He intended to assess any changes in their respective locations following the festival’s commencement.
target: Propositum principale eius in investigando Festo Somniorum fuit aurum Hisoka et rem ab Daemone familiae Nois adeptam invenire. Intendebat mutationes in locis eorum post initium festi aestimare.

source: If nothing surfaced, Lumian planned to seek out Padre Cali at the Saint-Sien Cathedral.
target: Si nihil emergeret, Lumian statuit Padrem Cali in Cathedralia Sancti Sieni quaerere.

source: The peculiar condition of “weakness in the depths of the Spirit Body” possessed by Padre Cali in reality set him apart from everyone else in Tizamo. This hinted at something distinctly special about the padre. Additionally, it was Padre Cali who had officially inaugurated the Dream Festival.
target: Singularis condicio "infirmitatis in profundis Corporis Spirituali" qua Padre Cali re vera praedita erat, eum ab omnibus in Tizamo distinguebatur. Hoc aliquid vere singulare de patre insinuabat. Praeterea, Padrem Cali Festo Somniorum officialiter inauguravisse ostendit.

source: Camus hesitated, his silence suggesting he might have pressing matters to attend to.
target: Camus haesitavit, silentio suo insinuante se negotia urgetia habere.

source: In that moment, Rhea regarded Lumian with confusion, gesturing towards Lugano.
target: In illo momento, Rhea Lumian spectavit confusa, ad Lugano indicans.

source: “Why is he still lucid?”
target: “Cur adhuc lucidus est?”
